d:
Ham apni pitaon dvara hatotsahit kuchh larke hain
Hamara kabhi nahin kiya gaya utsah vardhan
Hamare barhae ek qadam ke lie
Hamen dutkara gaya har bar bache rahe ninyanbe qadmon ke lie
Hamari manon ne bhi hamare bhale ke lie
Hamesha diya hamare pitaon ka sath
Ham khojte rahe jivan bhar
Khoji kukuron se apne achchhe karm
